description: Northern Province - The Northern Province Child Day Care Centre Statute No.03 of 2016
reasoning: This gazette content announces the enactment of the "Northern Province Child Day Care Center Statute No. 03 of 2016," which establishes a new legal framework for regulating, supervising, and monitoring child day care centers. It contains detailed statutory provisions including licensing requirements, inspection procedures, appeal mechanisms, and enforcement rules. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves the creation of new regulations and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
